answers.reason: The president chairs the central bodies of the university, which includes the senate.
The description does not explicitly include the president in the budget planning round, as the chancellor handles the budget.
The description does not state that the president is a member of the appointment committee.
The faculty council is led by the dean of the faculty, not the president.
The study commission is a faculty body, and the president leads the whole university rather than participating in individual faculty commissions.
The examination board decides on individual student matters at the faculty level, not involving the president.
The internal research funding round awards grants at the faculty level.
The module revision working group operates at the degree programme level within a faculty.
Laboratory equipment procurement is specific to faculty teaching laboratories.
Orientation week planning is an activity for new students at the faculty level.
